messages:
cara: quick heads-up: late-night deploy for auth-proxy at 01:30 UTC. want to try a micro-step FF ramp to catch auth cache thrash.

liam: schedule?

cara: plan: deploy with flag OFF; +5m -> 0.5%, +15m -> 2%, +35m -> 20%, +60m -> 100%. auto-rollback if error_rate>0.7% or auth-failure-rate rises. pin routing to proxy-v1 on rollback.

liam: add pause_on_alert=infra.* and sticky_cohort=internal_canaries.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle tb-6480050000-01; flag=auth_proxy_v2; steps=[+5m:0.5%,+15m:2%,+35m:20%,+60m:100%]; rollback_on=[error_rate>0.7,auth_fail>0.5]; pause_on_alert=infra.*; sticky_cohort=internal_canaries; initiator=cara

tess: QA will run `tests/smoke/auth_smoke.sh` after each step. Posting smoke results here.

ops-oncall: pin prepared pin-6480050000-eu; will apply on rollback. Kill command: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6480050000-01`. Dashboard link: (shared).

cara: deploying in 2.

(Deploy logs pasted)

```
Deploy started: auth-proxy v2
Image: registry/redwood/auth-proxy:v2.1
FF auth_proxy_v2=OFF
Instances: 6->6
Healthchecks: passing
```

deploy-bot: 0.5% toggle executed @01:35.

tess: smoke: internal_canaries ok; auth-failure 0.02%; p95 +10ms.

deploy-bot: 2% toggle executed @01:45.

ops-oncall: alert infra.auth_queue high at 01:48 -> pause.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alert infra.auth_queue; awaiting manual_confirm_on_pause.

liam: checking queue sources; looks like a transient upstream spike. if queue normalizes in 10m we can continue; otherwise rollback.

ops-oncall: queue normalized @01:55. manual resume?

cara: let's abort auto-resume. we'll inspect logs. for safety, rollback and pin — don't want to risk auth failures overnight.

deploy-bot: rollback executed @01:56: flag auth_proxy_v2=OFF; pin applied pin-6480050000-eu.

ops-oncall: pin verified, traffic restored to proxy-v1. post-rollback smoke green.

cara: added note to PR and runbook: "micro-step ramp paused due to queue spike; rollback & router pin applied. Reattempt after upstream stabilizes."

liam: follow-up action: add pre-check for queue-depth <50 before ramping next time.

deploy-bot: tb-6480050000-01 closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=cara; closed_at=6480050065
